why: The pale torn edge eating into the dark storm shows one world being wiped away for the next, and 'HERE BE MONSTERS' teases. The '3 IDIOTS' title over a Pirates-captioned sea is still confusing, but the visible change pulls me on.

'3 IDIOTS · The Workshop' sits on a dark stormy sea captioned 'The Kraken's Storm · Pirates of the Caribbean'. Nothing shows a transition, so it reads as a mislabelled slide, and the image is mostly black.
A glowing burn-hole eats through the RDR2 campfire photo under the 'HARRY POTTER' title. The page is visibly burning into the next world, and I'd scroll to see what is underneath.
The bold woodtype title is strong, but the framed photo is a near-blank, grainy sepia smear that looks like a failed or loading image. The section has nothing to grab me.
A gold spyglass circle reveals the lit stern of a ghost ship over a faint dark sea, under 'IN FOUR ACTS / PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN'. It's a cinematic opening that promises a story.
The same spyglass tease works, though the rest of the frame is flat black. It holds up only because the circle invites me to look through it.
The murky sepia photo alone would not hook me, but the 'EGG 1 OF 12 · THE KRAKEN' toast turns scrolling into a hunt. The pull comes from the collectible, not the section art.

The campfire image is lovely, but the act title says 'HARRY POTTER' while the caption says 'The Campfire · Red Dead Redemption 2'. Nothing yet signals that a change is coming, so it reads as a labelling error.
